No Expiry, No Refresh, No Rotation
The token is valid until the JWT_SECRET itself
changes. There is no refresh token, no rotation,
and no server-side revocation list — see
Any script that can execute in this origin (e.g. via
a future XSS bug) can read the token directly.
This is a real exposure only if such a bug exists
elsewhere — it is not itself an exploit.

svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Absent mechanisms — a refresh token, a server session, frontend JWT decoding — are named in a note, never drawn as implemented steps.
Every later protected request trusts this token's claims without re-checking them against the database — see AUTH-FLOW-01.
